bot.help_text:
**Self-Hosted WoWS Bot Commands (NA / EU / ASIA)**
• `{prefix} bind <na|eu|asia> <nickname>` — Bind account & enable tracking
• `{prefix} me` / `{prefix} <realm> <nickname>` — Player overview card
• `{prefix} ship <ship_name>` — Single-ship stats card
• `{prefix} recent [days]` — Recent performance card (default 7d)
• `{prefix} last` / `{prefix} recents` — Latest match / division report
• `{prefix} track on|off` — Toggle auto battle posting in this channel
• `{prefix} ship.rank <realm> <ship>` — Ship leaderboard
• `{prefix} clan <realm> <TAG>` — Clan overview
• `{prefix} roll [tier] [type]` — Random ship picker
• `{prefix} lang <zh|en>` — Switch language (default Chinese)
